note: world coords. The four South Park phones are one booth row at y~8722, all live at game start (red markers above each); the start arrow points at them (triangulated to (7927, 8602)). Standing on one accepts its job; the others go quiet until it ends. Probed on a 64-unit grid, so zone extents are unmeasured.

phones.brief: Crazy Jimmy's dumped a car in North East Park. Find it before...
The Angels wasted one of our guys and split with the shit. Bubby wants it back.
The new police chief wants a bigger cut. Bubby wants him dead...
We need two yellow cabs for a bank job. Bring 'em to the docks in New Guernsey.

pagers.message: YOU WANT YOUR JOB AT PIZZA SHED BACK? CALL ME! CHAD.
pagers.note: pager advert, not a phone: no job starts here, the arrow does not change
